mapper.sql: id::text AS id, name, description, instructions, enabled, version, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at) AS created_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM updated_at) AS updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_skills WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) ORDER BY name ASC
SELECT FROM agent_skills WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND name = #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

WITH owner_lock AS ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0)) ) INSERT INTO agent_skills(user_id, name, description, instructions, enabled) SELECT CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{instructions, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{enabled} FROM owner_lock WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_skills WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND name = #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) OR ( SELECT count(*) FROM agent_skills WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) ) < #{maxSkills} ON CONFLICT (user_id, name) DO UPDATE SET description = EXCLUDED.description, instructions = EXCLUDED.instructions, enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, version = agent_skills.version + 1, updated_at = now() RETURNING
